exposure: Planned place of birth (home vs. hospital)
outcome: Instrumental birth (caesarean section, vacuum, or forceps birth)
Oxytocin use in the third stage
cohort: 3495 low-risk women in midwife-led care at the onset of labor in the Netherlands in 2009 and 2010
finding: Women who planned home birth were more likely to have a spontaneous birth and fewer medical interventions, including episiotomy and oxytocin use in the third stage.
